title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: Eastern Nature Tour-I
main_content:
Eastern Nature Tour-I
EASTERN NATURE TOUR-I
BACK
Duration: 6 Nights/ 7 Days
Bhubaneswar-Buddhist circuit (Lalitgiri-Ratnagiri-Udayagiri)-Bhitarkanika N.P
DAY-01 : Arrival Bhubaneswar
Arrival at Bhubaneswar. Check-in to the hotel. After noon orientation tour of Bhubaneswar. Over night at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-02 : BHUBANESWAR
After breakfast, full day sightseeing of Bhubaneswar including Lingaraj temple, Mukteswar temple, Rajarani temple, 64 yogini temple, Khandagiri & Udayagiri Caves, Tribal museum. Evening visit to the traditional market-Ekamra Haat. Overnight at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-03 : BHUBANESWAR-BUDHHIST CIRCUIT-BHITARKANIKA N.P
After breakfast drive to Bhitarkanika N.P. En-route visit through Ratnagiri-Lalitgiri & Udaygiri Buddhist circuit. Arrival at Gupti & check-in to the Resort. Evening nature walk in the river bank. Overnight at Gupti.
DAY-04 : BHITARKANIKA N.P
After breakfast cruise in different creeks of Bhitarkanika to spot the crocodiles, different type of birds, Mangrove forest. Visit to Bagagahana-bird sanctuary, Sikarakathi-the hunting tower of ancient king, Shiv temple. Packed lunch will be served inside the boat. After lunch see crocodile breeding centre, museum, deer, water lizard etc. Overnight at Gupti.
DAY-05 : GUPTI-EKAKULA-HABALIKATHI
Early morning tea/coffee, nature walk, . After breakfast board on boat to Ekakula (depends upon the tide time). Arrival at Ekakula, relax on the lonely beach. After lunch board on boat to Habalikathi. Arrival at Habalikathi. Evening relax on the lonely beach. Overnight at Habalikathi.
DAY-06 : HABALIKATHI-HUKITOLA-GUPTI
After early breakfast board on boat to Hukitola-the historical monument on the Bay of Bengal. Arrival at Hukitola, nature trek. Board on boat and come back to resort (depend on tide time). Overnight at Gupti.
DAY-07 : GUPTI Departure
In time transfer to airport/railway station for onwards journey.

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: Odisha Dream Destination
main_content:
Odisha Dream Destination
ODISHA DREAM DESTINATION
BACK
Duration: 5 Nights/ 6 Days
Bhubaneswar- Puri-Chilika-Taptapani
DAY-01 : Arrival Bhubaneswar
Arrival at Bhubaneswar. Check-in to the hotel. Full day sightseeing of Bhubaneswar including Lingaraj, Mukteswar, Rajarani temple, 64 Yogini temple, State museum & Nandankanan zoological park. Evening visit to the traditional market ‘Ekamra Haat’. Over night at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-02 : Bhubaneswar-Konark-Puri.
After breakfast drive to Puri. En-route visit through Dhauli-the Buddist circuit, Pipli-the appliqué work village, Sun temple at Konark (the UNESCO world heritage village) , Chandrabhaga beach. Arrival at Puri & check-in to the hotel. Evening leisure at golden beach. Overnight at Puri.
DAY-03 : Puri
Early morning visit to the temple of universal God Lord Jagannath. Offer your puja. After breakfast drive to Satapada (one end of Chilika lagoon-the largest brakish water lagoon in Asia)
Cruise in the lagoon and explore sea mouth, Rajhans Island, rare Irrawady dolphins, local birds etc. Way back to Puri, visit Loknath temple. Rest of the day leisure at Puri. Overnigh at Puri.
DAY-04 : Puri-Barkul-Gopalpur
See the sun rise at the beach. After breakfast drive to Gopalpur-on-sea. En-route visit through Raghurajpur-the artisan village, Barkul(another end of Chilika lake), Cruise in the lagoon and explore Nalabana birds sanctuary (popular for migratory birds), Kalijai temple & Island. Arrival at Gopalpur and leisure at beach. Overnight at Gopalpur.
DAY-05 : Gopalpur-Chandragiri-Taptapani
After breakfast proceed to Chandragiri. Spent the whole day and come back to Taptapani. Overnight stay at Taptapani.
Chandragiri – a Tibetan village, during the Chinese aggression of Tibet in 1959, These Tibetan refugees crossed over to India along with the Dalai Lama and were allotted this spot. They built cottages and camps and a monastery resembling what they had left in Tibet. The newly built Monastry is the biggest in Asia.
DAY-06 : Taptapani-Bhubaneswar
After early breakfast drive to Bhubaneswar. En-route sightseeing of Khandagiri & Udayagiri jain caves. In time transfer to railway station for onwards journey.

main_content:
Odisha Golden Triangle-I
ODISHA GOLDEN TRIANGLE-I
BACK
Duration: 4 Nights/ 5 Days
Bhubaneswar-Ratnagiri-Lalitgiri-Udaygiri-Pipli-Konark-Puri
DAY-01 : Arrival Bhubaneswar
Arrival at Bhubaneswar. Transfer to the hotel. Half day city tour of Bhubaneswar including Bhaskareswar Temple, Rajarani Temple, Brahmeswar Temple,Vaitaldeol & Lingaraja Temple. (From View Point as Non Hindus are not allowed inside the Temple), Mukteswar & Parsurameswar Temple,Bindu Sagar. Overnight Bhubaneswar
DAY-02 : BHUBANESWAR-LALITGIRI-RATNAGIRI-UDAYGIRI-BHUBANESWAR
After breakfast, drive to Ratnagiri & Udayagiri group of Budhist monuments. Experience the different types of stupas & visit to ASI Museum.Visit to Lalitgiri group of monuments and Langudi.( If Time Permits).Visit to Gopal Pur handloom village.(If Time Permit) Over night Bhubaneswar.
DAY-03 : BHUBANESWAR-PIPLI-KONARK-PURI
After breakfast drive to Puri, En route visit to Dhauli-the Buddhist Peace Pagoda,64-Yogini Temple(Unique in Temple Architecture) Pipli-the appliqué work.,Sun temple at Konark (The UNESCO world heritage monument), Chandrabhaga beach. Arrival at Puri.Evening free for independent activity. Over night Puri.
DAY-04 : PURI-CHILIKA- RAGHURAJ PUR-BHUBANESWAR
Early morning sunrise at Puri sea beach. After early breakfast drive to Satapada (one end of Chilika lagoon) cruise in the largest brakish water lagoon of Asia and explore rare Irrawady dolphins, sea mouth, local & migratory birds.After lunch drive back to Bhubaneswar, en route visit through Raghuraj Pur.(UNESCO HERITAGE VILLAGE). Overnight Bhubaneswar
DAY-05 : BHUBANESWAR - Departure
After breakfast sightseeing of Tribal & State museum (Monday closed), Khandagiri & Udayagiri Caves.(jain Monuments) In time transfer to Airport for onwards journey.

main_content:
Odisha Nature Tour
ODISHA NATURE TOUR
BACK
Duration: 8 Nights/ 9 Days
Bhubaneswar-Buddhist circuit (Lalitgiri-Ratnagiri-Udayagiri)-Bhitarkanika N.P-Satkoshia-Bhubaneswar
DAY-01 : Arrival Bhubaneswar
Arrival at Bhubaneswar. Check-in to the hotel. After noon orientation tour of Bhubaneswar. Overnight at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-02 : BHUBANESWAR-BUDDHIST CIRCUIT-BHITARKANIKA N.P
After breakfast drive to Bhitarkanika N.P (Gupti). En-route visit through Ratnagiri-Lalitgiri & Udaygiri Buddhist circuit. Arrival at Gupti & check-in to the Resort. Evening nature walk in the river bank. Overnight at Gupti.
DAY-03 : BHITARKANIKA N.P
After breakfast cruise in different creeks of Bhitarkanika to spot the crocodiles, different type of birds, Mangrove forest. Visit to Bagagahana-bird sanctuary, Sikarakathi-the hunting tower of ancient king, Shiv temple. Packed lunch will be served inside the boat. After lunch see crocodile breeding centre, museum, deer, water lizard etc. Overnight at Gupti.
DAY-04 : GUPTI-EKAKULA-GUPTI
Early morning tea/coffee, nature walk, . After breakfast board on boat to Ekakula (depends upon the tide time). Arrival at Ekakula, relax on the lonely beach. After lunch board on boat to Gupti. Evening fee for independent activities. Overnight at Gupti.
DAY-05 : GUPTI-SATKOSIA WLS
Early morning nature walk on the river bank. After breakfast straight drive to Satkosia Wild life Sanctuary. Check-in to the forest guest house. Overnight at Satkosia WLS.
DAY-06 : SATKOSIA WLS
Morning go for a nature walk inside the forest. After breakfast enjoy the boat cruising in Satkosia Gorge and spot crocodiles. Overnight at Satkosia WLS.
DAY-07 : SATKOSIA-SAPTASAJYA-BHUBANESWAR
Morning you can enjoy the elephant ride. After breakfast drive to Bhubaneswar, en-route visit through Saptasajya-one of the best scenic destination. Evening free for independent activities. Overnight at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-08 : BHUBANESWAR
After breakfast full day sightseeing of Bhubaneswar including Lingaraj temple, Mukteswar temple, Rajarani temple, 64 yogini temple, Khandagiri & Udayagiri Caves, Tribal museum. Evening visit to the traditional market-Ekamra Haat. Overnight at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-09 : BHUBANESWAR Departure
In time transfer to Airport/Railway station for onwards journey.

heading: Western Odisha Glipms
main_content:
Western Odisha Glipms
WESTERN ODISHA GLIPMS
BACK
Duration: 4 Nights/ 5 Days
Sambalpur-Nrusinghanath-Harishankar-Debrigarh WLS
DAY-01 : Arrival Sambalpur
Arrival at Sambalpur and check-in to the hotel. If time permits sightseeing of deer park & Samaleswari temple. Evening free for independent activities. Overnight at Sambalpur.
DAY-02 : Sambalpur-Nrusinghanath-Harishankar-Bolangir
After early breakfast drive to Nrusinghanath- hill temple. Spent few times and have a bath in the beautiful series of water falls. Proceed to an another temple Harishankar which is at the foot of the Gandhamardan hills. It dazzles with a series of waterfall on the slopes. Later on see the deer park at Harishankar and proceed to Bolangir. Overnight at Bolangir.
DAY-03 : Bolangir-Hirakud-Sambalpur
After early breakfast drive to Hirakud-the longest dam of world and larges in Asia (746 sq kms in area) and a sore line over 640 kms stands across the Mahanadi river. A 21 kms drive on the dyke offers a unique experience. Proceed to Sambalpur. Overnight at Sambalpur.
DAY-04 : Sambalpur
After breakfast full day excursion trip to Chiplima-the second hydroelectric project of the Hirakud dam. A natural fall of 80 ft high in the river Mahanadi is made use for generating electricity. Ghateswari temple-the place is mostly inhabited by fishermen whose deity is ‘Ghantei’. Huma Leaning temple-a long leaning temple being the only of its kind in Odisha, also a cenic spot on the bank of the river Mahanadi. You can cruise in the river by country boat. Overnight at Sambalpur.
DAY-05 : Sambalpur Departure.
In time transfer to Railway station for onwards journey

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: Adventure & Trekking Tour
main_content:
Adventure & Trekking Tour
ADVENTURE & TREKKING TOUR-I
Duration: 15 Nights/ 16 Days
Destination: Gangtok-Lachen-Tallem-Jakthang-Yabuk-Darjeeling
DAY-01 : Arrival at BAGDOGRA-GANGTOK
Arrival at NJP Railway Station / (IXB) Bagdogra Airport, transfer to Gangtok – Capital of the 22nd State of India, Sikkim enjoys a mild, temperate climate all year round and offers spectacular views of the Himalayan ranges. This is a scenic and winding drive, takes you along the River Teesta which leads to the capital of Sikkim. Arrival at Gangtok, Check - in to Hotel. Overnight stay at Gangtok.
DAY-02 : GANGTOK
Drive / Trek - Gangtok Sight Seeing
Early morning after breakfast visit to the Rumtek Dharma Chakra Center, situated 24 kilometers from Gangtok. Way back visit Do-Drul Chorten Stupa, an inspiring stupa – Tibetology - An institution, devoted to Tibet logy.After lunch visit Institute of Handicrafts & Cottage Industries -. Overnight stay at Gangtok.
DAY-03 : GANGTOK-LACHEN
Drive - Gangtok - Lachen (2728 meters / 8950 feet) 125 kilometers, 6 - 7 hours
After breakfast drive by jeep passing through Tashi View Point, Kabi Lungtsok, Phodong Monastery, Mangan and Chungthang (approximately 95 kms). Lunch at Chungthang - Chungthang stands on an alpine meadow from which rise the pine clad mountains with their snowy peaks (approximately 30 kms from Chungthang). Overnight stay at Lachen.
DAY-04 : LACHEN
Trek - Lachen (2728 meters / 8950 feet) - Talem (3468 meters / 11, 378 feet) - 5 - 6 hours
After break fast, drive towards Zema (20 minutes). The trek starts from Zema to Tallem along the Zemu River towards west. The going in this section is usually slow as the path travels through water logged Rhododendron thickets and fallen tree trunks. Lunch at Tallem and in the afternoon free for exploring the area. Overnight stay at Camp.
DAY-05 : TALLEM-JAKTHANG
Trek - Tallem (3468 meters / 11, 378 feet) - Jakthang (3176 meters / 10,419 feet) 4 - 5 hours.
After breakfast Trek from Tallem to Jakthang . Some of the most magnificent forest areas for which Sikkim is famous for lies in this route. Cross a bridge to climb steadily through forest - Lunch at Camp. Afternoon free for independent activities. Overnight stay at Camp.
DAY-06 : JAKTHANG-YABUK
Trek - Jakthang (3176 meters / 10,419 feet) - Yabuk (3978 meters / 13,051 feet) 4 - 5 hours
After breakfast ,trek through forest and after a short climb it crosses a log bridge over Thomphyak Chu. One has to descend to the bank of the river Zemu Chu and follow the trail beside the river. The path to Yabuk climbs through the forest and after about three hours of steady walking reach the snout of the Zemu glacier. It is a small but beautiful camping area very cold and windy near the glacier. Lunch at Camp. Afternoon free for independent activities. Overnight stay at Camp.
DAY-07 : YABUK
Trek - Yabuk - (3978 meters / 13,051 feet - Camp - 4570 meters / 14,994 feet) - 5 Hours
After breakfast trek from Yabuk to Rest Camp follows the Zemu Glacier; The trail is through moraine field of the Zemu Glacier, crossing boulders and pebbles. As the trail opens into the valley the great peaks come into view. The Rest Camp is situated just opposite Mount Siniolchu which is one of the most beautiful peak of Sikkim. Overnight stay at Camp.
DAY-08 : REST CAMP
Trek - Rest Camp - (4570 meters / 14,994 feet) - Green Lake - (5050 meters / 16,568 feet) - 4 - 5 hours.
After breakfast trek from Rest Camp gently climbs up the valley. On a clear day this is one of the most beautiful walks in the Himalaya. Mount Siniolchu, Mount Simvo, Mount Kanchendzonga and Mount Chomolhari are some of the giants that dominate the horizon. A view one will cherish throughout the life. Overnight stay at Green Lake Plain.
DAY-09 : REST CAMP
Trek - Rest Day at an altitude of 5050 meters / 16,568 feet will give a feeling like staying at the top of the world
After breakfast full day sightseeing at Green Lake and nearby areas. Overnight stay at Green Lake.
DAY-10 : GREEN LAKE-YABUK
Trek - Green Lake - (5050 meters / 16,568 feet) - to Yabuk - (3978 meters / 13,051 feet)
After breakfast trek from from Green Lake to Yabuk in one day as the trail is mostly down hill and the descent is 1067 meters / 3500 feet - The road is nice and the trek easy. Overnight stay at Yabuk.
DAY-11 : YABUK-TALLEM
Trek - Yabuk - (3978 meters / 13,051 feet) - to Tallem - (3468 meters / 11, 378 feet) - 4 - 5 Hours
After breakfast advisable to trek back towards Yabuk with moderate pace and enjoy the beauty of the trek. Overnight stay at Tallem.
DAY-12 : TALLEM-LACHEN
Trek - Tallem - (3468 meters / 11, 378 feet) to Lachen (2728 meters / 8950 feet) - 4 - 4 ½ hours
After breakfast trek to Lachen.Trek through the varied flora and fauna of the region. The trek passes through the dense coniferous forests of Kanchendzonga National Park – This return journey is nostalgic . Overnight stay at Lachen.
DAY-13 : LACHEN-GANGTOK.
Drive - Lachen to Gangtok
After breakfast drive to Gangtok, Visit Phodong Monastery. Afternoon free for individual activities. Overnight stay at Gangtok.
DAY-14 : DARJEELING
After breakfast drive to Darjeeling. Afternoon free for indivisual activities. Overnight stay at Darjeeling.
DAY-15 : DARJEELING
Local Sight Seeing at Darjeeling
Early morning tour to Tiger Hills (at around 4 AM) to view sunrise over Kanchendzonga Peak (subject to clear weather). On the way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop (an Engineering marvel). After breakfast half - day sight seeing of Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park & Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Closed on Thursday), Tenzing & Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Center (Closed on Sunday) & Tea Estate OR visit to Rock Garden & Ganga Maya Lake. Over night stay at Darjeeling.
DAY-16 : Departure DARJEELING
After Breakfast – In time transfer to Railway Station/airport for connect Train/ Flight to further destination.

main_content:
Amarnath Yatra
Amarnath Darshan Via Pahalgam
BACK
DAY- 1 : Srinagar airport – Pahalgam 100 Kms
On arrival meeting at the airport and three hours drive will take you to Pahalgam 2440 Mtrs (vale of Kashmir) on the way visit Saffron fields, Avantipur ruins and Anantnag sulpher spring. Pahalgam is the most famous place for Indian Film Industry. Enjoy the nature charm of the valley. Overnight at Houseboat.
Day 02 : Pahalgam - Chandanwari - Sheshnag 13 Kms drive and 14 Kms trek
Leave early morning for and 13 Kms drive to Chandanwari immediately steep ascending Pisoo Ghati- 13500 ft which is the base. Overnight at Camping.
Day 03 : Sheshnag 3377 Mtrs - Panchtarni 14 Kms - Amarnath - Baltal - Sonmarg
Start early morning for a steep ascent upto Mahagunas ( The great Viper 14500 fts) with ups and downs walk upto the Panchtarni where you will stop for lunch and immediately start another 6 Kms trek to Amarnath ji Holy cave (3953 M) where you can see Ice Lingam. This is the Holy cave for Hidus and thousands of people visit the place during the full moon day. From Amarnath steep descent towards to Baltal 4 hours walk and short drive to Sonmarg. Overnight at Hotel.
DAY- 4 : Baltal- Sonmarg – Srinagar(113 Kms drive)
After breakfast leave for Srinagar airport which will take you about 3 hrs drive to reach Srinagar airport. Tour ends here..

Leave after early breakfast and short drive will take you to Baltal (Helipad) and board into the helicopter and short ride to Panchtarni by helicopter. Enjoy the Shikara ride on Dal Lake the beauty that God has graced this city with which is often compared to Venice and you will get a view of some very interesting places around the lake. Overnight at Houseboat/Hotel.
Day 04 : Srinagar
After breakfast free and transfer in time to the airport to connect onwards destination flight.

DAY-01 :Arrival in Bangkok
Arrival at Bangkok, Our Representative will assist you the transfer and check –in to hotel. Overnight at hotel.
DAY-02 : Full day Safari World or dream world with snow town
After breakfast take a day-long adventure trip to either safari world with marine park or Dream world. see live animal performances at safari world and explore the largest collection of wild and aquatic life at marine park or let your fantasies became reality dream world with magical 4D show and fun rides for all ages . Lunch is include at all parks. Overnight at hotel. .
DAY-03 :Sightseeing in Bangkok and Transfer to Pattaya
After breakfast at the hotel, proceed for a half day city & temple tour ending with a visit to the Gens factory. In the afternoon transfer and check – into hotel in Pattaya. Evening at leisure.
DAY-04 : Coral island with Lunch
After breakfast proceed for coral island tour, famous for colorful coral reef and marine life. Ride into a speed boat to Coral island. Hop in a glass bottom boat to view marine life. Lunch will also be provided. Enjoy the optional water sports like parasailing, snorkeling and windsurfing. Overnight at hotel.
DAY-05 : Transfer & Departs from Bangkok
After breakfast at hotel, enjoy the day at leisure for last minute shopping and other activities of your choice .check out from hotel and transfer to the airport.

heading: Bike Safari Tour
main_content:
Bike Safari Tour
BIKE SAFARI TOUR-I
Duration: 14 Nights/15 Days
Destination: Delhi-Manali-Keylong-Sarchu-Leh-Pangong-Nubra Valley-Kargil-Sringar-Patnitop-Jammu
Day-1 : Arrival at DELHI –MANALI (585 kms)
Arrival at Delhi. Meet & greet by our office representative who will assist you to board your vehicle to Monali (585 kms/14 hrs). Arrival at Monali and check-in to the hotel. Overnight stay at Manali.
DAY- 2 : MANALI
Collect bikes and get checked for air and oil, Manali sightseeing on bike, vsit to Hidimba temple, Manali market, Fuel tank top-up. Overnight stay at Manali.
DAY- 3 : MANALI – KEYLONG (115 kms)
After early breakfast biking to Keylong.
Attractions -Rohtang La – At an altitude 13,051 ft ,its a high mountain pass on the eastern Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas. It connects the Kullu Valley with the Lahaul and Spiti Valleys of Himachal Pradesh, India. Overnight stay at Keylong.
DAY- 4 : KEYLONG - SARCHU
After breakfast biking to Sarchu.
Attractions-Bara-lacha La – At 16,040 ft its a high mountain pass in Zanskar range, connecting Lahaul district in Himachal Pradesh to Ladakh in Jammu and Kashmir, situated along the Leh-Manali highway. Overnight stay at Sarchu.
DAY-5 : SARCHU – LEH (100 kms)
After breakfast biking to Leh.
Attractions-Gata Loops – Succession of 21 hairpin bends taking you from 13780 ft to 15302 ft-Nakee La - 16,230 ft -Lungalacha La - 16,601 ft-Morey Plains - Plains for about 40 kms straight at 14,763 ft. is part of Great Tibetan Chamathang plateau-Tanglang La – Second highest motorable mountain pass in India at 17,582 ft. Overnight stay at Leh.
DAY-6 : LEH MONASTRY CIRCUIT
After breakfast full day sightseeing of Shey Palace & Monastery – The Shey Monastery & Shey Palace was built in 1655. The main Shakyamuni Buddha statue in the monastery is a 12 metres (39 ft) icon covering three floors of the monastery. Thikseonastery – The Thiksey Monastery, situated at 12,000 ft, is a 12-storey complex, noted for its images and mural paintings of Buddhist art displayed variously in its stupas, statues, thangkas, wall paintings and swords.Hemis Monastery – The Hemis Monastery, situated on the south of Leh, which is one of the largest and most famous monasteries, belongs to the Drukpa order. Shanti Stupa - The Japanese for World Peace built the Shanti Stupa, at Changspa, on the hilltop, and was inaugurated by Dalai Lama in 1985. Leh Palace, Stok Gompa and Stok Palace . Overnight Leh.
DAY-7 : LEH – PANGONG TSO (154 kms)
After breakfast visit to Mighty Chang La -The Chang La at 17,800 ft is the third highest motorable road in the world-It is named after the sadhu Changla Baba, to whom the Pass temple is dedicated. Pangong Tso-It is the largest salt water lake in Asia situated at an altitude of about 14,300 ft-It is 134 km (83 mi) long and extends from India to China. 60% of the length of the lake lies in China. The lake is 5 km (3.1 mi) wide at its broadest point. During winter, the lake freezes completely, despite being saline water. It is a fantastic experience to see the lake at different times of the day. Moon rise and sun rise by the lake side are beautiful views. Overnight stay at Pngong Tso.
DAY-8 : PANGONG - LEH
After breakfast biking to Leh.
Man & Merak-Be the first one to travel along the banks of the Pangong Lake in Leh, right up to the villages of Man and Merak. Travel back to Leh & Visit Phyang Festival. Overnight stay Leh.
DAY-9 : LEH – NUBRA VALLEY
After breakfast biking to Nubra Valley-Khardung La (K-Top)-The pass on the Ladakh Range lies north of Leh and is the gateway to the Shyok and Nubra valleys.-Built in 1976, it was opened to motor vehicles in 1988 and has since seen many automobile, motorbike and mountain biking expeditions. Khardung La at 17,582ft is widely, but incorrectly, believed to be the world's highest motorable pass
Diskit Monastery-Diskit Monastery is situated on the hill, just above the flood plains of the Shayok River, on its right bank in the Diskit village (3,144 metres (10,310 ft)) in Nubra Valley.
It is the oldest (350 years) and largest Buddhist monastery (gompa) in the Nubra Valley, which was once part of the famous Caravan Route between Tibet . Overnight stay at Nubra Valley.
DAY-10 : NUBRA VALLEY - LEH
After breakfast visit to the sand dunes and take a ride on the double humped Bactrian camels. Ride back to Leh. Hunder-Hunder is about 7km further and it is the last point civilians can go. Further from Hunder is Siachen glaciers. Hunder is famous for the sand dunes and double humped Bactrian camels. These camels are believed to have been abandoned by the passing caravans centuries ago and have flourished there. Lachung temple-is the oldest temples in the Nubra Valley where a large idol of Tsong Khapa is deified and a Gelugpa yellow hat crowns the image. Overnight stay at Leh.
DAY-11 : LEH – KARGIL (234 kms)
After breakfast Biking to Kargil. Magnetic Hill- is a gravity hill located near Leh in Ladakh, India. The hill is alleged to have magnetic properties strong enough to pull cars uphill and force passing aircraft to increase their altitude in order to escape magnetic interference; in reality, the effect is an optical illusion created by the gravity hill. Pathar Sahib Gurudwara-The Gurdwara was built in 1517 to commemorate the visit of Guru Nanak Dev, the founder Guru of the Sikh faith, to the Ladakh region. Fotu La - At 13,605 ft, it is the highest point on the Leh - Srinagar highway. Lamayuru Monastery- Lamayuru is one of the largest and oldest gompas in Ladakh. Lamayuru is also called the Moonland View for the fantastic moonscapes it offers . Namika La – High pass at 12,204 ft. Overnight stay at Kargil.
DAY-12 : KARGIL – SRINAGAR (204 kms)
After breakfast sightseeing of Kargil and biking to Srinagar. Kargil – Visit Vijay Smarak to pay a tribute to soldiers who laid their lives for us in Kargil War in 1999. En route have a magnificent view of Kargil war Famous Peaks (Tiger Hill, Tololing). Drass - The second coldest inhabited place on Earth, with temperatures dropping to - 60 C in winter. The road after Kargil follows closely along the Line Of Control between India and Pakistan, and signs along the road remind travellers that they are "under enemy observation". Zoji La - Zoji La, at 11,578 ft from sea level, is the last mountain pass on the road from Ladakh to India’s infamous north-western part, Kashmir. After Zoji La the scenery changes from Ladakh's barren and brown to Kashmir's green forests. On the way visit Sonmarg – Sonamarg means ' meadow of gold ' has, as its backdrop, snowy mountains against a cerulean sky. the Sindh meanders along here and abounds with trout and mahseer, snow trout can be caught in the main river.
DAY-13 : SRINAGAR – PATANI TOP (157 kms)
After breakfast sight seeing of Srinagar – Visit to Dal Lake for boating, Visit to Shankaracharya Math. After sightseeing leave for Patani Top. Overnight stay at Patani Top.
DAY-14 : PATANI TOP – JAMMU (112 kms)
After breakfast sightseeing of Patani Top.
Patni Top, at an altitude of 6640ft, is a hill top tourist location in Udhampur district on the National Highway 1A, on the way from Udhampur to Srinagar. It is located in the Shiwalik belt of the Himalayas, and is in Jammu and Kashmir, India. The river Chenab flows in close proximity to this location.
After sightseeing biking to Jammu. Deposit the bike to send for native place. Overnight stay at Jammu.
DAY-15 : JAMMU- DEPARTURE…
After breakfast in time transfer to Railway Station / Airport for further destination

Budhist Tour
NORTHERN BUDDHIST TOUR
BACK
Duration: 8 Nights/9 Days
Destination: Delhi-Gaya-Bodhgaya-Rajgiri-Nalanda-Varanasi-Gorakhpur-Kushinagar-Lumbini-Agra
DAY - 1 : Arrival at DELHI
Arrival at Delhi. Traditional welcome. Transfer to Railway Station for Gaya. Over night in Train.
DAY-2 : GAYA-BODH GAYA
Arrival at Gaya Railway station. Transfer to Bodh gaya. Check in to hotel. Full day sightseeing of Bodh gaya including Mahabodhi temple & Niranjana river, Thai temple, Japanese temple and Buddha statue. Overnight at Bodh gaya.
DAY-3 : BODHGAYA- RAJGIRI-NALANDA - GAYA
After early breakfast, drive to Rajgiri. Arrival at Rajgir. Sightseeing of Bimbimsara Jail, Gridhakut hill, Venuvan. After lunch, proceed to Nalanda world famous University & Nalanda Museum. Drive back to Gaya Railway station. Board on train for Varanasi. Overnight in Train.
DAY-4 : VARANASI
Arrival at Varanasi. Transfer to hotel. After break fast, full day sightseeing of Sarnath, Dhamekh stupa, Sarnath museum, The Ashokan pillar, Mulgandha kuti vihar. Evening witness Ganga Arati .Transfer to Railway station. Board on Train for Gorakhapur. Overnight in Train.
DAY-5 : GORAKH PUR – KUSHI NAGAR
Arrival at Gorakhpur. Transfer to Hotel. After breakfast visit to Mahaparinirvan temple, Rambhar stupa, Mata kutir temple. Evening witness chanting and meditation session. Overnight stay at Kushinagar.
DAY-6 : KUSHINAGAR – LUMBINI- GORAKHA PUR
After early breakfast drive to Lumbini (Nepal). Arrival at Lumbini and sightseeing of Maya Devi temple, Ashokan pillar and Pushkarni lake. Drive back to Gorakhapur. Board on Train to Gonda. Overnight in Train.
DAY-7 : GONDA- SRABASTI- GONDA-AGRA
Arrival at Gonda Railway station. Transfer to Sravasti. After breakfast sightseeing of Jetvana Vihara, Pakki kuti & Sehat mahet, Thai temple. Drive back to Gonda Railway station, Board on Train to Agra. Overnight in Train.
DAY-8 : AGRA
Arrival at Agra. Visit to Taj Mahal, Agra Fort. Afternoon free for Independent activity.
Overnight stay at Agra.
DAY-9 : AGRA – DELHI Departure
After breakfast drive to Delhi & In time transfer to airport for further destination.

heading: Budhist Tour
main_content:
Budhist Tour
EASTERN BUDDHIST TOUR
BACK
Duration: 10 Nights/11 Days
Destination: Bhubaneswar-Chandragiri-Ratnagiri-Lalitgiri-Udayagiri-Konark-Gangtak-Darjeeling
DAY-1 : Arrival at BHUBANESWAR
Arrival at Airport/Railway station. You will be greeted by our representative who will assist you to board your vehicle to Hotel. Check-in to the Hotel. If time permits half day city tour includes, State museum, Temples like Lingaraj, Rajarani, Mukteswar, 64 Yogini temple. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-2 : BHUBANESWAR-CHILIKA LAKE-TAPTAPANI
After breakfast proceed to Taptapani. En route visit through Chilika Lake (Largest brakish water lake in Asia). Cruise inside the chilika lake and spot the places like Nalabana birds sanctuary ( popular for migratory birds in winter), Kalijai temple in Kalijai island. Lunch at Barkul then proceed to Taptapani. Afternoon sightseeing of deer park, hill nature view and hot sulpher spring. Overnight stay at Taptapani.
DAY-3 : TAPTAPANI-CHANDRAGIRI (35 kms)
Morning proceed to Chandragiri. Spend the whole day here and come back to Taptapani. Overnight stay at Taptapani.
Chandragiri- a Tibetan village, during the Chinese aggression of Tibet in 1959, these Tibetan refugees crossed over to India along with the Dalai Lama and were allotted this spot. They built cottages and camps and a monastery resembling what they had left in Tibet. The newly built Monastry(Padmasambhava Mahavihar) which is the biggest in Asia was inaugurated by His Holiness Dalai Lama on January 12, 2010. It is built on 10 acres of area. It took almost 10 years to complete it. Mahavihar is a four-storied complex with a massive prayer hall and place of worship with 200 resident monks.
DAY-4 : TAPTAPANI-PURI
Morning drive to Puri. Arrival at Puri and check-in to the hotel. Evening free for independent activities. Overnight stay at Puri.
DAY-5 : PURI-KONARK-BHUBANESWAR
After breakfast proceed to Bhubaneswar. En route visit through Konark Sun temple ( World heritage sight), Kuruma, Dhauli-the Buddhist pagoda. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-6 : BHUBANESWAR-LALITGIRI-RATNAGIRI-UDAYAGIRI
After breakfast, drive to Ratnagiri & Udayagiri group of monuments. See the art & architect of the ruined Buddhist monuments, stupas, Museum. Then visit to Lalitgiri group of monuments and the stone work of Lalitgiri & Langudi. After lunch at way side Dhaba back to Bhubaneswar. Overnight stay at Bhuabneswar.
DAY-7 : BHUBANESWAR-BAGDOGRA-GANGTAK
Morning proceed to Airport to connect flight to Bagdogra. Arrival at Bagdogra then proceed to Gangtak (5500ft/1677 mts, 130 kms/4-5 hrs). Evening free for independent activities. Overnight stay at Gangtak.
DAY-8 : GANGTAK
Whole day sightseeing of different monastery of Gangtak. Overnight stay at Gangtak.
DAY-9 : GANGTAK-DARJEELING
After breakfast, transfer to Darjeeling (7380 ft/ 2250 mts, 115 kms/5-6 hrs). Afternoon go for a half day sightseeing of Japanese temple, Peace Pagoda. Overnight stay at Darjeeling.
DAY-10 : DARJEELING
Early morning tour to Tiger Hills (8364 ft/2550 mts at around 4 am) to view sunrise over Kanchendzonga peak. On way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, Tenzing & Gombu Roack, Tebetan Regugee Self-help center (closed on Sunday) & Tea estate. Overnight stay at Darjeeling.
DAY-11 : DARJEELING-BAGDOGRA Departure
In time transfer to Bagdogra airport for onwards journey.

main_content:
Central India Tour
CENTRAL EXOTIC
BACK
Duration: 14 Nights/ 15 Days
Destination: Bhopal-Sanchi-Mandu-Indore-Ujjain-Shivpuri-Gwalior-Orchha-Bandhavgarh-Jabalpur-Bhedaghat-Kanha N.P-Pachmarhi-Pench-Nagpur
DAY- 1 : Arrival at BHOPAL
Arrival at Bhopal Railway Station/Airport, will be met by our office representative who will assist you to board your vehicle to Hotel. Check in to the Hotel & fresh up. Bhopal is a fascinating amalgam of scenic beauty, a proud heritage and modern urban planning. Sightseeing of beautiful mosques like Taj-ul-Masjid ( said to be one of the three largest mosques of world and the largest in Asia), Jama Masjid, quaint palaces like Shaukat Mahal and Sadar Manzil, Gauhar Mahal, State Museum, Birla Museum etc. O/N at Bhopal
DAY-2 : BHOPAL-SANCHI (48 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Sanchi (48 kms/1hrs) and sightseeing of Stupas, monasteries, temples & pillars dating from the 3rd century B.C to the 12th century A.D. Afternoon enjoy the boat ride in Bada Talab ( Upper Lake) of Bhopal. O/N at Bhopal
DAY- 3 : BHOPAL-BHOJPUR-BHIMBETKA (28-40 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Bhimbetka (68 kms/1.5 hrs). En route sightseeing of 11th century Shiva temple, Bhojeshwar at Bhojpur. After arrival at Bhimbetka sightseeing of rock-cut paintings that date back to the early stone age at the Vindhya mountain range which is covered by huge rocks. Back to Bhopal. If time permits sightseeing of Bhopal. O/N at Bhopal.
DAY- 4 : BHOPAL-MANDU (186 kms)
After early breakfast proceed to Mandu- the city of Joy ( 186 kms/3.5 hrs). Sightseeing of Darwazas, Jahaz Mahal, Hindola Mahal etc. O/N at Mandu.
DAY-5 : MANDU-INDORE-UJJAIN ( 99-55 kms)
After early breakfast proceed to Ujjain (154 kms/3 hrs). En route sightseeing of Indore like Rajwada, Lal bagh Palace, Kanch Mandir (Jain temple), Bada Ganapati (largest statue of Ganapati in the world)
Arrival at Ujjain and check in to the hotel. aleswara ( one of the 12 Jyotirlinga). O/N at Ujjain.
DAY-6 : UJJAIN
Whole day sightseeing of Ujjain like Mahakaleswar temple (one of the 12 Jyotirlinga), Bada Ganesh ji ka Mandir, Harsiddhi temple, Bhartrihari Caves, Kaliadeh Palace etc. O/N at Ujjain.
DAY-7 : UJJAIN-SHIVPURI (343 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Shivpuri. O/N at Shivpuri.
DAY-8 : SHIVPURI-GWALIOR (112 kms)
First half sightseeing of Shivpuri like Madhav Vilas Palace, Chhatris (Centaphs), Bhadaiya Kund- a scenic picnic spot. After Lunch proceed to Gwalior (112 kms/2 .5 hrs). O/N at Gwalior.
DAY-9 : GWALIOR-ORCHHA (118 kms)
First half sightseeing of Gwalior like Gwalior Fort, The Man Mandir Palace, Jai Vilas Palace and Museum etc. After lunch proceed to Orchha ( 118 kms/2.5 hrs. O/N at Orchha.
DAY-10 : ORCHHA-KHAJURAHO (170 kms)
First half sightseeing of Orchha like Fort Complex and Palaces, Rai Praveen Mahal, Jahangir Mahal etc. After lunch proceed to Khajuraho (170 kms/ 3.5 hrs). O/N at Khajuraho.
DAY-11 : KHAJURAHO
Whole day sightseeing of Khajuraho like temples of Khajuraho & its erotic sculptures, Laxman temple, Kandariya Mahadev temple, Jagadambi temple, The Chitragupta temple etc. O/N at Khajuraho.
DAY-12 : KHAJURAHO-BANDHAVGARH (237 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Bandhavgarh N.P( 237 kms/ 5 hrs). Park round in the evening. O/N at Bandhavgarh N.P.
DAY-13 : BANDHAVGARH
Whole day round the park and spot tigers, deer, sambar, nilgai etc. sightseeing of Fort, Bandhavgarh hill. Enjoy the elephant ride. O/N at Bandhavgarh.
DAY- 14 : BANDHAVGARH-JABALPUR (190 kms)
After early breakfast proceed to Jabalpur (190 kms/4.5 hrs). Check in to the hotel & fresh up. After lunch Sightseeing of Marble Rocks, Dhuandhar Falls by boating on the crystal-clear waters of the Narmada. O/N at Jabalpur
DAY-15 : JABALPUR Departure.
In time transfer to Airport/Railway station for onward

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: East India Tour
main_content:
East India Tour
A visit to the exotic land cradled between the sunlit water of the Bay of Bengal and the lush green forested blue-hued hills of the Eastern Ghats can be an experience for the life time.Magnificent temples of Jagannath, Konark and Lingaraj, Pristine beaches & Ethinic Culture in Orissa, Hill stations Darjeeling in West Bengal, Mangroves of Bhitarkanika and the Sundarban, White tigers and Royal Bengal Tigers, Buddhist and Jain monuments in Bihar, Orissa, Chattisgarh, beautiful tribal people with their traditional best in Orissa, Chattisgarh, Jharkhand and West Bengal.

Chilika Lake-Gopalpur-Taptapani
DAY – 1 : Arrival BHUBANESWAR
Arrival at Bhubaneswar Airport/Railway station. You will be greeted by our office representative who will assist you to board your vehicle. Transfer to Hotel. Orientation tour of Bhubaneswar. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-2 : BHUBANESWAR-NUAPATANA-DHENKANAL ( 110 kms-40 kms) / 3 hrs-1hrs)
After breakfast, proceed to Nuapatana, Mania Bandah (110 kms/ 3 hrs), the largest weaver village (Silk/Pata Saree) & the only Buddhist village in Odisha. See the Handloom work of Pata/Silk sarees. Then proceed to Sadeibareni for Dokra work, the typical tribal handicrafts of Odisha. Overnight stay at Dhenkanal.
DAY-3 : DHENKANAL-RATNAGIRI-LALITGIRI-CHANDIPUR
After breakfast, drive to Ratnagiri & Udayagiri group of monuments. See the art & architect of the ruined Buddhist monuments, Museum. Then visit to Lalitgiri group of monuments and the stone work of Lalitgiri. After lunch at way side Dhaba proceed to Chandipur-on-sea. Enjoy the evening at the rare beach resort Chandipur. Overnight stay at Chandipur-on-sea.
DAY-4 : CHANDIPUR-CUTTACK-BHUBANESWAR (216 kms)
After breakfast, drive to Cuttack (186 kms/4 hrs). Enroute visit to Gopalpur for handloom & Teracotta work. Arrival at Cuttack and visit to filigree work centre & shops. Evening free for Indipendent activity. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-5 : BHUBANESWAR-KONARK-PURI (100 kms)
After breakfast, drive to Puri (100 kms/2.5 hrs). En-route visit to Dhauli peace pagoda, stone work centre, Sun temple at Konark, ASI Museum, Chandrabhaga beach, Stone work centre at Ramchandi. Afternoon darshan of Universal God Lord Jagannath (Non-Hindus are not allowed). Evening free for independent activities. Overnight stay at Puri.
DAY-6 : PURI- SATAPADA (CHILIKA LAKE) ( 50 kms)
Early morning drive to Satapada ( Dolphin end of Chilika Lake) (50 kms/1.5 hrs). Cruise inside the lake to sight rare Irrawady dolphins, mouth point of Chilika lake, red crabs centre. Have your packet breakfast inside the boat. Back to Puri and have your Lunch. After luch visit to Raghurajpur (Unesco heritage village). Each family of this village engaged in handicraft works, visit to other handicraft villages, Handicraft shops. Evening enjoy in the golden beach/ independent activities. Overnight stay at Puri.
DAY-7 : PURI-BARKUL ( CHILIKA LAKE)-GOPALPUR (195 kms)
After breakfast drive to Barkul ( other side of Chilika lake) (140 kms/3 hrs). Boating inside the Chilika lake and see the Nalabana bird sanctuary (popular for migratory birds), Kalijai temple in Kalijai island. Lunch at Barkul. After lunch proceed to Gopalpur-on-sea ( 76 kms/2.5 hrs). Evening enjoy in the Gopalpur beach. Overnight stay at Gopalpur.
DAY-8 : GOPALPUR-TAPTAPANI ( 75 kms)
Early morning Sunrise at Gopalpur beach. After breakfast drive to Taptapani (75 kms/2.5 hrs). En route see the handloom work & show room of silk saris at Silk city Berhampur, visit to the Matha handloom work at Padmanavpur. Arrival at Taptapani and check-in to the hotel. Afternoon sightseeing of deer park, hill nature view and hot Sulpher spring. Overnight stay at Taptapani.
DAY-9 : TAPTAPANI-BHUBANESWAR ( 220 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Bhubaneswar (220 kms/5.5 hrs). En route visit to the another weaving village Olansuni . Then drive to Routpada ( The second largest weavers village in Odisha). See the PATA handloom work. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-10 : BHUBANESWAR
After breakfast full day city tour including temples like Lingaraj, Rajarani, Mukteswar, Khandagiri & Udayagiri rock cut caves, Tribal museum & Nandankanan Zoological park. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-11 : Departure BHUBANESWAR
In time transfer to Airport/Railway station for onwards journey.

heading: East India Tour
main_content:
East India Tour
EASTERN WILD ADVENTURE
BACK
Duration: 9 Nights/ 10 Days
Destination: Bhubaneswar-Bhitarkanika N.P-Similipal N.P-Chandipur
DAY-1 : Arrival BHUBANESWAR
Arrival at Bhubaneswar Airport/Railway station. You will be greeted by our office representative who will assist you to board your vehicle. Transfer to Hotel. Afternoon Orientation tour of Bhubaneswar. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-2 : BHUBANESWAR-GUPTI (170 kms)
After breakfast, drive to Ratnagiri & Udayagiri group of monuments(120 kms/3 hrs). See the art & architect of the ruined Buddhist monuments, Museum-a large collection of excavation (closed on Friday). Then visit to Lalitgiri group of monuments & the stone work. After lunch at way side Dhaba proceed to Gupti. Evening enjoy the nature trek and feel the continues cool air. Overnight stay at
Gupti.
DAY-3 : BHITARKANIKA NATIONAL PARK
After breakfast proceed to Pentha sea beach and Satabhaya ethnic village. Spent the half day in this lonely place and feel the cool nature. Have your packet lunch. Come back to Gupti. Overnight stay at Gupti.
DAY-4 : BHITARKANIKA NATIONAL PARK
After breakfast cruise in different creeks like Gadhirapal, Suajore etc to spot Crocodiles, then visti to Bagagahana ( Bird Sanctuary) where during winter you can see many migratory birds, Sikarakathi ( hunting tower of ancient king), Shiv temple. Have your lunch at Dangamal forest restaurant and see crocodile breeding centre, Museum, deer, Water lizard etc. Overnight stay at Gupti.
DAY-5 : GUPTI-LULUNG (SIMILIPAL N.P) (295 kms)
After breakfast, proceed to Lulung (Similipal N.P) (295 kms/6 hrs). Have your lunch at road side Dhaba. Arrival Similipal N.P and check in to the Forest Lodge. After noon enjoy the scenic beauty and feel the sound of the nature. Overnight stay at Forest Guest house.
DAY-6 : SIMILIPAL NATIONAL PARK
After breakfast start for Jungle ride. Sightseeing of Jaranda water fall (181 mtr) where a watch tower with glass house available for observing wild beauty of forest, Nawana- a green valley with crop lands. One additional attraction of this place is the lifestyle of the tribals residing in the valley. Barehipani water fall (217 mtr) where river Budhabalanga runs to the plain land. Chahala- where sighting of wild animals are more. Over night stay at Forest Guest house.
DAY-7 : LULUNG-CHANDIPUR (101 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Chandipur-on-sea (101 kms/2.5 hrs). En route visit through Khirachora Gopinath temple, Balaramgadi fishing harber. After noon enjoy at the unique beach (where sea recedes up to 5 kms and again come to shore two time in a day). Over night stay at Chandipur-on-sea.
DAY-8 : CHANDIPUR-BHUBANESWAR (216 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Panchalingeswar hill temple & Stream ( 46 kms/1 hrs). Then proceed to Bhubanewar (200 kms/4 hrs). Have your lunch at road side dhaba. Evening free for independent activities. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-9 : BHUBANESWAR
After breakfast full day city tour including temples like Lingaraj, Rajarani, Mukteswar, Khandagiri & Udayagiri rock cut caves, Tribal museum & Nandankanan Zoological park. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-10 : Departure Bhubaneswar
In time transfer to Airport/Railway station for onwards journey.

heading: Eastern Textile Tour
main_content:
Eastern Textile Tour
EASTERN TEXTILE TOUR
Duration: 10 Nights/ 11 Days
Destination: Bhubaneswar-Nuapatana-Dhenkanal-Sonepur-Sambalpur-Bargad-Sonepur-Bolangir-Baliguda-Berhampur-Gopalpur-Chilika Lake
DAY-1 : Arrival BHUBANESWAR
Arrival at Bhubaneswar Airport/Railway station. Transfer to Hotel. Half day sightseeing of Bhubaneswar including Lingaraja, Parsurameswar, Mukeswar, Rajarani Temple.Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-2 : BHUBANESWAR-MANIABAND-NUAPATNA –DHENKANAL.
After breakfast, drive to Nuapatana & Mania Bandah (110 kms/ 3 hrs), the largest weaver village (Silk/Pata Saree) & the only Buddhist village in Odisha. Experience the Handloom work of Pata/Silk sarees. After lunch drive to Sadeibareni for Dokra work, the typical tribal handicrafts of Odisha.
Overnight stay at Dhenkanal.
DAY-3 : DHENKANAL-SAMBALPUR
After breakfast drive to Sambalpur, en route visit through rock painting at Redhakhol. Evening visit to Samaleswari temple. Overnight stay at Sambalpur
DAY-4 : SAMBALPUR-BARPALI
After breakfast drive to Barpali weekly market( Commence only on Friday),visit to different weaver village like Barpali-the largest weaver village in western Odisha. Evening visit to different handloom shop. Overnight stay at Sambalpur.
DAY-5 : SAMBALPUR-SONEPUR-BALANGIR
After breakfast drive to Sonepur, en route visit through Huma-the leaning temple. See the most popular Sambalpuri silk weaver villages at Sonepur.Drive to Balangir and overnight.
DAY-6 : BALANGIR-BALIGUDA
After breakfast proceed to Baliguda, en route covering some weaver village. Visit some Kutia Kondh tribal village. Overnight stay at Baliguda.
DAY-7 : BALIGUDA-TAPTAPANI-GOPALPUR
After breakfast visit Taptapani-the hot sulphuric hot spring water, Padmanavpur popular for matha handloom work. Then drive to Gopalpur on sea. Overnight stay at Gopalpur on sea.
DAY-8 : GOPALPUR-BERHAMPUR-BARKUL
Early morning sunrise at Gopalpur-on-sea. After breakfast proceed to Berhampur and see the handloom work & showroom at Silk City Berhampur. Then proceed to Barkul. Afternoon enjoy the boat ride in chilika lake. Overnight stay at Barkul.
DAY-9 : BARKUL-BHUBANESWAR
Early Morning boating in side chilka lake, explore the Nalabana Island, Kalijai Island. After lunch drive to Bhubaneswar en route visit through Onlasuni & Routpada weaver village. Overnight stay at Bhubaneswar.
DAY-10 : BHUBANESWAR
After breakfast full day sightseeing of Bhubaneswar including Khandagiri & Udayagiri Caves,Tribal Museum, State Museum ( Monday Closed),64 Yogini Temple. Evening free for independent activities.
DAY-11 : BHUBANESWAR Departure
In time transfer to Airport for onwards journey.

Experience Malaysia & Singapore
EXPERIENCE MALAYSIA & SINGAPORE
BACK
Duration: 6 Nights/7 Days
KUALA LUMPUR-SINGAPORE-Sentosa Island
DAY-01 :KUALA LUMPUR- GENTING (Batu Caves)
Arrival at Kualalumpur. Transfer to Genting. Enroute visit Batu Caves. Check onto Genting at 1500 Hrs. Dinner in Indian Restaurants. Overnight in Genting
(Imp Note: - Genting Rooms are Subject to availability)
DAY-02 : GENTING-KUALA LUMPUR (Outdoor Theme park )
After breakfast, get ready to set out and explore more of this wonderful place .Enter a world of fantasy and adventure at the Genting Outdoor Theme Park. Enjoy unlimited rides, games, shows, mini trains, boating on the lake,Lunch in Indian Restaurant Evening will take a transfer to Kuala Lumpur. Dinner will be served at Indian Restaurant. Overnight in Kuala Lumpur
DAY-03 :KUALA LUMPUR (Kul City tour)
After Breakfast, Check out from hotel we proceed on a panoramic city tour of the sprawling capital city of Kuala Lumpur, covering Merdeka Square, Pass by National Mosque & photo shoot only, Thean Hou Temple, Handicraft Centre etc. in guided city tour with photo stops wherever possible. Some of the places covered in the city tour are as follows: KINGS PALACE: Istana Negara is the official residence of the King, located on a hillock. Green lawns, ponds and trees surround the palace.Lunch and Dinner in Indian restaurant. Overnight in Kuala Lumpur .
DAY-04 :SINGAPORE (Night Safari)
After Breakfast, Coach from KUL-SIN .Arrive Singapore. Check in to hotel @ 1400 hrs. Evening Night Safari.Dinner will be served at Indian Restaurant. Overnight at your Hotel (Meal: B+D)
DAY-05 :SINGAPORE (City tour + Sentosa Island)
After breakfast, After breakfast will proceed for City tour get ready to experience the mega metropolis of Singapore.Lunch in Indian Restaurant.After Lunch transfer to the Sentosa Island. There you will enjoy the, under water World, Spectacular Musical Song Of the Sea, Dolphin Lagoon etc.Dinner will be served at Indian Restaurant. Overnight at your Hotel (Meal: B+L+D)
DAY-06 :SINGAPORE (Universal Studio)
After Breakfast in Hotel. Transfer to Universal Studio with Lunch Coupon. Transfer back hotel. Dinner in Indian restaurant . Overnight at your Hotel.
DAY-07 :SINGAPORE Departure
After breakfast at the hotel. Check out from your hotel and transfer to the Airport to board the flight for India. Arrive India with happy memories!!! Tour End.

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: HORNBILL FESTIVAL
main_content:
HORNBILL FESTIVAL
ITINERARY –I
BACK
Duration: 08 Nights/ 09 days
Destination: Guwahati-Kaziranga-Dimapur-Kohima-Touphema-Mukukchung-Jorhat
Day 01 (29th Nov, 2011) ARRIVE GUWAHATI / KAZIRANGA:
Assistance on arrival at Guwahati pre noon and transfer to Kaziranga National Park (240kms/5hrs). Overnight Kaziranga.
Day 02 (30th Nov, 2011) KAZIRANGA / DIMAPUR:
Early morning go for an elephant safari followed by a jeep safari after breakfast. Post lunch drive to Dimapur (120kms/4hrs). Overnight at Hotel Dimapur.
Day 03 (1st Dec, 2011) DIMAPUR / KOHIMA:
After breakfast drive to the Kisema village (120kms/4hrs) where the Hornbill festival is held and be a part of the festival on the inauguration day. Overnight at Dimapur.
Day 04 (2nd Dec, 2011) AT KOHIMA:
Overnight at Kohima.
Day 05 (3rdDec, 2011) AT HORNBILL FESTIVAL
Full day at the Hornbill festival. Overnight at the hotel.
Day 06 (4th Dec, 2011): KOHIMA / TOUPHEMA:
Visit the State Museum, the handloom and handicraft emporium is a treasure house of traditional weaves along with the souvenir shops. The State Museum showcases some of the most fascinating aspects of Naga tribal life in all its variety and wealth of tradition. It also houses some of the ancestral weaponry, carved gateposts, status pillars that record Feasts of Merit and traditional Naga costumes and jewellery. In short it gives an overview of tribal lifestyles and the history of the Nagas.
Afternoon drive to Tuophema village (40kms/2hrs)-a tourist village resort and a unique initiative on community tourism. Experience the heritage and charm of the Angami tribe. Overnight Touphema.
Day 07 (5th Dec, 2011): TOUPHEMA/ MOKUKCHUNG:
Early morning drive to Mokokchung (142kms/5hrs) via Wokha. Overnight at Mokokchung .
Day 08 (6th Dec, 2011): MOKUKCHUNG/ JORHAT:
After breakfast drive to Jorhat (120kms/4hrs). Overnight at Jorhat.
Day 09 (7th Dec, 2011) JORHAT / FLY OUT
After breakfast drive to the airport at Jorhat to board flight for Kolkata.

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: HORNBILL FESTIVAL
main_content:
HORNBILL FESTIVAL
ITINERARY –II
BACK
Duration: 10 Night/11 Days
Destination: Guwahati-Jorhat-Mon-Kokokchung-Touphema-Kohima-Kaziranga N.P
DAY 01: GUWAHATI – JORHAT
Arrival at Guwahati airport,drive to Jorhat (07 hrs), after a brief welcome you will be escorted to hotel, evening at leisure. Overnight at Leisure.
DAY 02: JORHAT – MON
Today after breakfast drive to Mon - Mon – located at an altitude of 897.64 meters above sea level is the land of Konyak Nagas, they were one of the great warriors among Nagas. Afternoon go for a walk through the Mon Market. Overnight at Mon.
DAY 03: MON
After breakfast, drive to Shangnyu village - this village is ruled by the Chief Angh is a prominent village in Mon district. There is a wonderful wooden monument measuring 8 feet in height and 12 feet in breadth- believed to be constructed by heavenly angels, on way visit Mon village. After lunch drive to Longwa village (41 kms) which is in the border of India and Burma. In this village one can also see the traditional from of making opium. Evening at leisure. Overnight at Mon.
DAY 04: MON – MOKOKCHUNG
After breakfast we drive to Mokokchung (220 kms / 9 hrs approx) located at an altitude of 1325 meters above sea level, this picturesque town is the cultural center of the Ao tribes. The Ao Nagas is famous for their colourful dances. Overnight at Mokokchung.
DAY 05: MOKOKCHUNG – TOUPHEMA
After breakfast visit one village and then drive to Tuophema village (167 kms / 05 hrs) . Enroute visit the Rengma and Lotha tribal villages. Over night at Tuophema village.
DAY 06: TOUPHEMA – KOHIMA
After breakfast we proceed to Kohima – the capital of Nagaland (40 kms / 02 hrs), to attain the opening ceremony of Hornbill festival.
HORN BILL FESTIVAL
The Horn Bill Festival of Nagaland represents the Bicultural extravaganza of the northeast Indian state. The Nagaland festival provides tourists the opportunity to glimpse of the festive celebrations of the state. The festival starts in the first week of December every year and it continues for a week. Nagaland is the land of festivals with one festival following the other all through the year.
Evening at leisure. Overnight at Kohima.
DAY 07: KOHIMA
Full day attain Hornbill Festival. Overnight at Kohima.
DAY 08: KOHIMA
Full day attain Hornbill festival. Overnight at Kohima.
DAY 09: KOHIMA–KAZIRANGA NATIONAL PARK
After breakfast drive to Kaziranga National Park (217 KMS / 07 HRS).
Kaziranga National Park
In the heart of Assam, covering an area of 430 sq-kms, is inhabited by the world's largest population of one-horned rhinoceroses, as well as many mammals, including tigers (sighting of tigers are difficult), elephants, hog & swamp deer, water buffaloes and almost 478 species of birds (both migratory and residents). In 1985, it was declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO for its unique natural environment.
Evening free at leisure. Overnight at Kaziranga.
DAY 10: KAZIRANGA NATIONAL PARK
After an early wake up, you will be taken to the riding point in the Central Range (Kohoro) for an Elephant Ride. After the ride return back to the lodge, having breakfast at 7 am drive to the Central Rang (Kohora) of the park for a jeep safari. After lunch at 2.15 there will be another Jeep safari in the Western Range (Baguri) of the park. Evening at leisure. Overnight at Kaziranga.
DAY 11: KAZIRANGA NATIONAL PARK – GUWAHATI
After breakfast drive to Guwahati airport for onward destination.

heading: Ladakh Tour
main_content:
Ladakh Tour
LADAKH TOUR-I
Duration: 5 Nights/ 6 Days
Destination:
Day 1: Leh
Arrival at leh airport, you will be met by our representative at the airport and escort you to Hotel. Complete day for the acclimatization which is 3500 Mtrs above sea level. In the evening short walk around Leh bazaar Overnight at Hotel.
Day 2: Leh – Monasteries
After breakfast day excursion to the famous monasteries, it is interesting to visit early in the morning to enjoy the praying ceremony at Thiksey monastery. Continue drive to Hemis monastery which is one of the most famous monasteries of the Ladakh region. On the way back visit to Shey Palace. Overnight at Hotel.
Day 3: Leh- Alchi – Uletokpo 75 Kms
After breakfast drive to Uletokpo camping which is one of the most beautiful camping in the Ladakh region on the way visit Spituk monastery which is just 5 kms from Leh town. Continue drive to Alchi monastery is the only monastery in the Ladakh on flat ground. By the lunch time you will reach Uletokpo. Evening enjoy to sit on the bank of river coming down from the Ridzong side. Overnight at Camp.
Day 4: Uletokpo – Lamayuru – Leh 180 Kms
After breakfast drive Uletokpo and continue drive to Lamayuru via Khaltsi. From here another 22 Kms drive will take you to Lamayuru. The oldest and spectacularly set Lamayuru monastery founded in the 10th Century. Visit the monastery. In the late afternoon drive back to Leh which will take about 4/5 hours drive, on the way back we stop at magnetic hill. Overnight at Hotel.
Day 5: Leh – Khardongla Pass – Leh 85 Kms
After breakfast full day excursion to Khardongla pass which is the highest motorable pass in the world 5600 Mtrs and has been recorded in the Gunnies Book of world records. At the top enjoy the nature beauty of snow capped mountain. In the evening back to the hotel. Overnight at Hotel.
Day 6: Leh – Delhi
In time transfer to the airport to connect onwards destination flight.

heading: Magical Malaysia
main_content:
Magical Malaysia
MAGICAL MALAYSIA
BACK
Duration: 3 Nights/4 Days
Kuala Lumpur-Gentling Highlands
DAY-01 :Arrival In Kuala Lumpur & Transfer To Gentling Highlands.
Arrival in kuala Lumpur.Our representative will be assist you with the transfer to Genting and check into hotel .Enjoy the day at Genting Highlands with entrance to the outdoor Theme park at over 6000 feet above see level, thrilling rides for all ages, go shopping at the first world Plaza . Overnight at hotel.
DAY-02 : Transfer to Kuala Lumpur
After breakfast transfer to Kuala Lumpur. Check into hotel, rest of the day for leisure. Overnight at hotel.
DAY-03 :Kuala Lumpur Sightseeing
After breakfast proceed for a half day city tour of Kuala Lumpur. This tour gives you a colourful spectrum of Malaysian architecture ,history , culture ,heritage ,crafts and lifestyle .Highlight of the tour include PETRONAS Twin Towers, Lake Garden and Chinatown .In the afternoon you will have time for shopping and leisure activities of your choice . Overnight at hotel.
DAY-04 : Depart from Kuala Lumpur
After breakfast at hotel, enjoy the day at leisure for last minute for shopping and over activities of your choice. Check out from hotel and transfer to the airport.

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: North East Tour (Sikkim Tour).
main_content:
North East Tour (Sikkim Tour).
EASTERN HIMALAYAN-I
BACK
Tour Duration: 2 Nights/ 3 Days
Destination: Gangtak-Darjeeling
DAY- 01 : Arrival NJP RAILWAY STATION /BAGDOGRA AIRPORT - GANGTOK
Arrival at NJP Railway Station / (IXB) Bagdogra Airport, (500Ft / 150Mts) will be met by our office Executive who will assist you to board your vehicle to Gangtok (5500 Ft /1677 Mts, 130 Kms / 04 to 05 Hrs). Check in and over night stay at Gangtok.
DAY- 02 : GANGTOK
After breakfast, in the morning, start for excursion to Tshangu Lake - situated at a height of 12400Ft / 3780 Mts / 43 kms in 3 hrs one way, with an average depth of 50 ft. The cool water of the Lake is perfectly attuned with the scenic beauty around. Back to Gangtok and Overnight stay at Gangtok.
DAY- 03 : GANGTOK - DARJEELING
After breakfast, transfer to Darjeeling (7380 Ft / 2250 Mts, 115 Kms / 05 to 06 Hrs). Afternoon go for a half-day sight seeing of Japanese Temple, Peace pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park & Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Closed on Thursday), Tenzing & Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Center (Closed on Sunday) & Tea Estate. Overnight stay at Darjeeling.
DAY -04 : DARJEELING - NJP RAILWAY / IXB AIRPORT Departure
Early morning tour to Tiger Hills (8364 Ft / 2550 Mts at around 4 AM) to view sunrise over Kanchendzonga Peak (subject to clear weather). On way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop. After breakfast in time transfer to NJP Railway Station / (IXB) Bagdogra Airport (100 kms / 03 to 04 hrs ) for your onward connection.

SIKKIM DELIGHT
BACK
Duration: 10 Nights/ 11 Days
Destination: Gangtak-Lachung-Yumthang-Pelling-Kalimpong-Darjeeling
DAY- 01 : Arrival NJP RAILWAY STATION / BAGDOGRA AIRPORT - GANGTOK
Arrival at NJP Railway Station / (IXB) Bagdogra Airport, (500Ft / 150Mts) will be met by our office Executive who will assist you to board your vehicle to Gangtok (5500 Ft /1677 Mts, 130 kms / 04 to 05 hrs). Check in and over night stay at Gangtok.
DAY -02 : GANGTOK
After breakfast, in the morning, start for excursion to Baba Mandir & Tshangu Lake - situated at a height of 12400Ft / 3780 Mts / 43 kms in 3 hrs one way, with an average depth of 50 ft. The cool water of the Lake is perfectly attuned with the scenic beauty around. Back to Gangtok and Overnight stay at Gangtok.
DAY- 03 : GANGTOK - LACHUNG
Pick from Gangtok Hotel and transfer to Lachung (8000 Ft / 2439 Mts / 124 kms / 05 ½ to 06 ½ hrs). On the way visit Tashi view point, Kabi Longtsok, Seven sister’s water fall Singhik view point, Lunch on route and Overnight stay at Lachung
DAY- 04 : LACHUNG - YUMTHANG - LACHUNG
Early morning proceed on a half day excursion to Yumthang Valley (11800 Ft / 3598 Mts / 25 kms / 1 ½ hrs one way). On the way visit the Hot Spring and Singba Rhododendron Sanctuary. Overnight stay at Lachung.
DAY- 05 : LACHUNG - GANGTOK
After breakfast transfer to Gangtok. En-route visit through Bhim Nala water fall & Twin water fall. Overnight stay at Gangtok.
DAY- 06 : GANGTOK – PELLING
Morning Go for a half day sightseeing covering Jhakri Water Falls (04 hrs) along with Droul Chorthen, Research Institute of Tibetology, Directorate of Handicraft & Handloom (Closed on Sunday), Flower Show . Afternoon transfer to Pelling (6100 Ft / 1860 Mts, 116 kms / 05 to 06 hrs). Overnight stay at Pelling.
DAY- 07 : PELLING
After breakfast we drive to Yuksom (5840 Ft / 1780 Mts, 35 kms / 02 hrs) on way visit Darap Village, Rimbi Water fall & Hydro Project, Khecheopalri Lake (6000 Ft / 1829 Mts), itis one of the sacred Buddhist mountain lake and it is believed that whatever is wished in front of the lake comes true. Myth is that when a leaf falls on the placid clear water surface, it is picked by a bird & Kanchanjunga Water fall. A further drive takes you to Yuksom (the meeting place of three monks) - the first capital of Sikkim. This was the place where the first Chogyal (a ruling dynasty in Sikkim) was crowned. Evening Back to Pelling and Overnight stay.
DAY- 08 : PELLING - KALIMPONG
After breakfast transfer for Kalimpong (3937 Ft / 1200 Mts, 115 kms / 05 to 06 hrs). Overnight stay at Kalimpong.
DAY- 09 : KALIMPONG - DARJEELING
Today after Breakfast visit Dello hills, Dr. Graham’s Home, Flower Nurseries, Jang – Dong - Palriffo Brang and Durbin Dara Hills. Transfer to Darjeeling (7380 Ft / 2250 Mts, 70 kms / 04 to 05 hrs). Overnight stay at Darjeeling.
DAY- 10 : DARJEELING
Early morning tour to Tiger Hills (8364 Ft / 2550 Mts at around 4 AM) to view sunrise over Kanchendzonga Peak (subject to clear weather). On way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop. After breakfast go for a half-day sight seeing of Japanese Temple, Peace pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park & Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Closed on Thursday), Tenzing & Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Center (Closed on Sunday) & Tea Estate. Overnight stay at Darjeeeling.
DAY- 11 : DARJEELING - NJP RAILWAY / IXB AIRPORT - Departure
After breakfast in time transfer to NJP Railway Station / (IXB) Bagdogra Airport (100 kms / 03 to 04 hrs) for your onward connection.

DAY- 04 : LACHUNG - YUMTHANG - LACHUNG
Early morning proceed on a half day excursion to Yumthang Valley (11800 Ft / 3598 Mts / 25 kms / 1 ½ hrs one way). On the way visit the Hot Spring and Singba Rhododendron Sanctuary. Overnight stay at Lachung.
DAY- 05 : LACHUNG - GANGTOK
After breakfast transfer to Gangtok. En-route visit through Bhim Nala water fall & Twin water fall. Overnight stay at Gangtok.
DAY- 06 : GANGTOK – PELLING
Morning Go for a half day sightseeing covering Jhakri Water Falls (04 hrs) along with Droul Chorthen, Research Institute of Tibetology, Directorate of Handicraft & Handloom (Closed on Sunday), Flower Show . Afternoon transfer to Pelling (6100 Ft / 1860 Mts, 116 kms / 05 to 06 hrs). Overnight stay at Pelling.
DAY- 07 : PELLING
After breakfast we drive to Yuksom (5840 Ft / 1780 Mts, 35 kms / 02 hrs) on way visit Darap Village, Rimbi Water fall & Hydro Project, Khecheopalri Lake (6000 Ft / 1829 Mts), itis one of the sacred Buddhist mountain lake and it is believed that whatever is wished in front of the lake comes true. Myth is that when a leaf falls on the placid clear water surface, it is picked by a bird & Kanchanjunga Water fall. A further drive takes you to Yuksom (the meeting place of three monks) - the first capital of Sikkim. This was the place where the first Chogyal (a ruling dynasty in Sikkim) was crowned. Evening Back to Pelling and Overnight stay.
DAY- 08 : PELLING - KALIMPONG
After breakfast transfer for Kalimpong (3937 Ft / 1200 Mts, 115 kms / 05 to 06 hrs). Overnight stay at Kalimpong.
DAY- 09 : KALIMPONG - DARJEELING
Today after Breakfast visit Dello hills, Dr. Graham’s Home, Flower Nurseries, Jang – Dong - Palriffo Brang and Durbin Dara Hills. Transfer to Darjeeling (7380 Ft / 2250 Mts, 70 kms / 04 to 05 hrs). Overnight stay at Darjeeling.
DAY- 10 : DARJEELING
Early morning tour to Tiger Hills (8364 Ft / 2550 Mts at around 4 AM) to view sunrise over Kanchendzonga Peak (subject to clear weather). On way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop. After breakfast go for a half-day sight seeing of Japanese Temple, Peace pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park & Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Closed on Thursday), Tenzing & Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Center (Closed on Sunday) & Tea Estate. Overnight stay at Darjeeeling.
DAY- 11 : DARJEELING - NJP RAILWAY / IXB AIRPORT - Departure
After breakfast in time transfer to NJP Railway Station / (IXB) Bagdogra Airport (100 kms / 03 to 04 hrs) for your onward connection.

heading: North India Tour
main_content:
North India Tour
HEAVENLY HIMACHAL
BACK
Duration: 6 Night/7 Days
Destination: Chandigarh-Shimla-Kullu-Manali
DAY-1 : Arrival CHANDIGARH
Arrival at Chandigarh Airport/Railway station. You will be greeted by our representative who will assist you to board the vehicle. Drive to Shimla(125kms/3 hrs), check-in to the Hotel. Spend the evening at leisure. Overnight stay at Shimla.
DAY-2 : SHIMLA-KUFRI(16 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Kufri. Visit through Indira Bungalow & Himalayan Zoo. After lunch sightseeing of Jakhu hill, Mall Road, Church and Scandal Point. Evening free for individual activities. Overnight stay at Shimla.
DAY-3 : SHIMLA-MANALI (280 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Manali (280 kms/1926 mtrs/9-10hrs), Enroute drive past Beas-Sutlej Link Project & Pandoh Dam. Lunch at wayside restaurant. See the Shawl factory at Kullu. Arrive at Manali and check-in to the Hotel. Overnight stay at Manali
DAY-4 : MANALI
After breakfast, go for a half day sightseeing tour and visit Vashistha temple &Kund, Hadimba temple, Manu temple, Gayatri temple. 2nd half free for individual activities. Overnight stay at Manali.
DAY-5 : MANALI-RATANG PASS (52 kms)
After breakfast, go for an excursion to snow point on Rohtang Pass (4112 mts/52 kms/2 hrs). Visit through Kothi and Rahalla falls. Return to Manali. Overnight stay at Manali.
DAY-6 : MANALI-CHANDIGARH ( 397 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Chandigarh (397 kms/11-12 hrs). Lunch at way-side Dhaba. Arrive at Chandigarh and check-in to the Hotel. Overnight stay at Chandigarh.
DAY-7 : CHANDIPARGH Departure
In-time transfer to Airport/Railway station for onwards journey.

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: North India Tour
main_content:
North India Tour
SPLENDID KASHMIR
BACK
Duration: 5 Night/6 Days
Destination: Srinagar-Pahalgaon-Gulmarg-Sonmarg
DAY-1 : Arrival SRINAGAR
Arrival at Srinagar Airport. You will be greeted by our representative who will assist you to board the vehicle. Check-in to house boat. Afternoon Sikara ride in Dal Lake. O/N stay at Srinagar (House boat).
DAY-2 : SRINAGAR-PAHALGAON(96 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Pahalgaon (2130 mts/96 kms/3.5 hrs). Arrival at Pahalgaon which is the Kashmir’s most popular destination, surrounded by high mountains, dense forests, high mountain lakes, valley, Kolhai glacier. Sightseeing of Shesh Nag, Chandanwari (route to the skiing, pony trails, angling, horse riding, trekking etc. O/N at Pahalgaon.
DAY-3 : PAHALGAON-GULMARG (148 kms)
After breakfast proceed to Gulmarg (148 kms/5 hrs) known as the ‘Meadow of Flowers’. Gulmarg- historically a favourite haunt of Emperor Jahangir.Gulmarg today is not merely a mountain resort of exceptional beauty- it also turns into india’s premier ski resort in winter. After Lunch enjoy gondola rides, pony rides etc. and enjoy the scenic beauty. O/N stay at Gulmarg.
DAY-4 : GULMARG-SRINAGAR (52 kms)
For noon proceed to Srinagar (52 kms/2 hrs). After Lunch sightseeing of Mughal garden. Evening free for independent activities. O/N stay at rinagar.
DAY-5 : SRINGAR-SONMARG (82 kms)
Early morning proceed to Sonmarg the ‘Meadow of Gold’ (82 kms/4 hrs). The drive through this valley presents a spectacular facet of the Kashmir countryside. Sonmarg is surrounded by colourful mountains and thick pine forests. Enjoy a pony ride on the glacier. Come back to Srinagar. O/N stay at Srinagar.
DAY-6 : SRINAGAR Departure
In-time transfer to Airport for onwards journey.

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: North India Tour
main_content:
North India Tour
LEH-LADAKH
BACK
Duration: 05Nights/06Days
Destination: Leh-Khardongla Pass-Alchi-Uletokpo-Lamayuru
DAY-1 : Arrival Leh.
Arrival at Leh airport. Meet & greet by our office representative, who will assist you to board on vehicle to Hotel. Full day for the acclimatization which is 3500mtrs above sea level. Evening short walk around Leh market. O/N-Leh.
DAY-2 : Leh-Khardongla Pass-Leh (45kms/02-03hrs one way)
After breakfast full day excursion to Khardongla pass which is the highest motorable pass in the world (5600mtrs) and has been recorded in the Gunnies Book of world records. At the top enjoy the nature beauty of snow capped mountain. Evening back to the Hotel. O/N-Leh.
DAY-3 : Leh-Alchi-Uletokpo (75kms/4.5hrs one way)
After breakfast leave for Uletokpo camping which is one of the most beautiful camping in the Ladakh region, en-route visit Spituk Monastery which is just 5 kms from Leh town. Continue drive to Alchi Monastery-the only Monastery in the Ladakh on flat ground. Evening enjoy to sit on the bank of river coming down from the Ridzong side. O/N-At Camp.
DAY-4 : Uletokpo-Lamayuru-Leh (180kms/5.5 hrs )
After breakfast leave Uletokpo and drive to Lamayuru via Khaltsi. From here another 22kms drive will take to Lamayuru. The oldest and spectacularly set Lamayuru monastery founded in the 10th Century. Visit the monastery. In the late afternoon drive back to Leh which will take about 4/5hours drive, on the way back we stop at magnetic hill. O/N-Leh.
DAY-5 : Leh-Pangong Lake-Leh (290kms/ )
Leave early morning at 5AM to Pangong Lake, en-route Changla pass (5486mtrs). Enjoy the beautiful panoramic view of the villages below the pass. After crossing the pass halt for picnic lunch at Tsoltak-the summer pasture land of the yaks. Arrive Durubuk and from there a short drive takes you to the western shore of the lake. Enjoy the landscape in the back drop of the Lake. This famous blue brackish lake of Pangong is 5/6 kms wide and over 144kms long with half of it’s running the other side of the “INDO CHINA BORDER”. One rarely feels so close to nature and environment and the scenery is unforgettable. In the late afternoon drive back to Leh. O/N-Leh.
DAY-6 : Leh Departure
After breakfast in-time transfer to Airport/NJP railway station for onwards journey.

title: :: Welcome to Eastern Risen ::
heading: Singapore Delight
main_content:
Singapore Delight
SINGAPORE DELIGHT
BACK
Duration: 3 Nights/4 Days
Singapore-Jargon bird Park
DAY-01 :Arrival in Singapore
Arrival in Singapore. You will be welcome by our Representative who will assist you with the transfer and check-in to hotel. In the evening, proceed for an exciting Night safari adventure. This 40-hectare park comes alive after dark, with over 1200 animals engaging in their fascinating and nightly rituals. Overnight at hotel.
DAY-02 : Singapore City Tour and Sentosa island with underwater world
After breakfast at hotel, proceed for a panoramic half-day city tour. Driving pass the colonial buildings, government houses, Little India and Chinatown, Singapore’s famous icon, the marine. See the world’s largest fountain with a base area of 1683 square meters-the “Fountain of Wealth”. in the afternoon, Visit sentosa Island including a trip to underwater world, home to more than 2500 fishes. Overnight at hotel.(Meals: Breakfast)
DAY-03 :Jargon bird Park and Shopping
After breakfast at hotel, proceed for Jurong Bird park ,home to over 9000 birds. Take a ride on air conditioned panorail for a panoramic view of the park and into a tropical world of jungle mist at the waterfall Aviary. Afterward, enjoy a spectacular show where you will meet all the stars of the park- snowy the Swan, crazy Bird, Toukie the Toucan and many more. The evening is free for shopping and other leisure activities. Overnight at hotel (Meals: Breakfast)
DAY-04 :Depart from Singapore
After breakfast at hotel, enjoy the day at leisure for last minute shopping and other activities of choice. Check out from hotel and transfer to the airport.

SOUTHERN HERITAGE
BACK
Duration: 11 Night/ 12 Days
Destination: Bengaluru-Hassan-Mysore-Trichy-Tanjore-Madurai-Kancheepuram-Mahabalipuram-Chennai
DAY-01 : Arrival- BENGALURU
Arrival at Bengaluru. You will be greeted by our representative who will assist you to board your vehicle to Hotel. Check-in to the Hotel. Halfday city tour includes,Lal Bagh, Gole Temple, the Government Building, Vishveshwara Industrial and Technology Museum and the Ulsoor Lake. Overnight stay at Bengaluru.
DAY-02 : BENGALURU- HASSAN ( 194 kms)
After breakfast, drive to Hassan(194 kms/3.5 hrs) .After noon sightseeing of Chennakeswara Temple at Belur, and the Hoyasaleswara Temple at Halebid. Overnight stay at Hassan.
DAY-03 : HASSAN-MYSORE (118 kms)
After breakfast, drive to Mysore (118 kms/2 ½ hrs). Enroute visit to Srabanbelagola, Srirangam. Arrival at Mysore. Check into Hotel. Evening free for independent activities. Overnight at Mysore.
DAY-04 : MYSORE
After breakfast, full day sightseeing of Mysore including the magnificent Maharaja’s Palace, Chamundi Temple, and the Art Gallery, visit the fruits and flower markets. Overnight stay at Mysore.
DAY-05 : MYSORE-TRICHY ( 276 kms)
After breakfast, drive to Trichy (276 kms/5-6 hrs). Check in to the Hotel. Afternoon free for individual activities. Overnight stay at Trichy.
DAY-06 : TRICHY & TANJORE
After breakfast, full day sight seeing of Trichy & Tanjore including, Rock Fort, Srirangam, one of the largest temple of God Vishnu, and the Jambkeswaram temple of Lord Shiva submerged in water. Subramaya temple of Tanjore. Overnight stay at Trichy.
DAY-07 : TRICHY – MADURAI (140 kms)
After breakfast, drive to Madurai (140 kms/2.5-3 hrs). Enroute visit to Cocoanut Rope work. Afternoon free for individual activities. Overnight stat at Madurai.
DAY-08 : MADURAI
After breakfast, fullday sightseeing of Madurai including Meenakshi Temple,Nayak Palace and the daily village market. Evening witness the night garland ceremony at meenakshi temple. Overnight stay at Madurai.
DAY-09 : MADURAI-CHENNAI (453 kms)
After breakfast ,in time transfer to airport for connect flight to Chennai. Arrival at Chennai & transfer to Hotel. Evening free for independent activities. Overnight stay at Chennai.
DAY-10 : CHENNAI
After breakfast, full day excursion to Kanchipuram and Mahabalipuram.
Kancheepuram : known as the Golden city of a thousand temples. This is one of India’s sacred cities. Many early styles of temple architectural design; the Five Radhas-a group of monolithic monuments and animal figures carved out of solid rock; the Shore Temple, lashed by the waves of the Sea; and the huge frescoe; ‘The Penance of Bhagirathi’.
Mahabalipuram : An ancient coastal port South of Madras, here you will see many sculptures and temples of typical South India architectural designs; the five Radhas - A group of Monolithic monuments of animal figures carved out of solid rock; the shore temple, lashed by the waves of the sea, and the Huge frescoes; the penance of Bhagirath. Overnight Chennai.
DAY-11 : CHENNAI
After breakfast, fullday city tour including cathedral and the Fort of St. George. Visit the Marina Beach- second longest beach in the world, its an elegant promenade; Fort St. George- the first foothold of British from where Robert Clive started the expansion of British Rule. Evening free for Indipendent activities. Overnight at Hotel.
DAY-12 : CHENNAI- Departure
After breakfast, in-time transfer to airport for connect flight to further destination.

Duration: 09 Nights/ 10 Days
Places covered: Delhi-Guwahati-Kolkata-Bhubaneswar-Konark-Puri
DAY-1 : Arrival DELHI
Arrival at Delhi. Transfer to hotel. After fresh up, half day sight seeing of Old Delhi. O/N-Delhi.
DAY-2 : DELHI
After breakfast in time transfer to Airport for connecting flight to Guwahati. Arrival at Guwahati, transfer to hotel. Afternoon boating inside the river Brahmaputra. Visiting to the Umanand temple (Lord Shiva). O/N-Guwahati.
DAY-3 : GUWAHATI
After breakfast visit to Kamakhya temple, experience the Kumari pujan (girls’ worship). Visit to Kamakhya group of temples.After lunch visit to Sualkhosi-Silk textile village. O/N-Guwahati.
DAY-4 : GUWAHATI-KOLKATA
After breakfast visit to Vasistha Ashram, Hajo,Temple of Madan kamdev, Creamation ground of Bhutnath. In time transfer to
Airport for connecting flight to Kolkata. Arrival at Kolkata and transfer to hotel. O/N-Kolkata.
DAY-5 : KOLKATA
After breakfast full day sightseeing of Kolkata including Kalighat, Dakhineswar Kali, Belur Math & Ramakrishna Mission. O/N-Kolkata.
DAY-6 : KOLKATA- BHUBANSWAR
In time transfer to Airport for connecting flight to Bhubaneswar. Arrival at Bhubaneswar and check in to the hotel. After
refreshment sightseeing of temples like Lingaraj, Mukteswar, Rajarani & 64 Yogini temple. Evening meditation in a Yoga centre. O/N-Bhubaneswar.
DAY-7 : BHUBANESWAR
Early morning practice of meditation & yoga in a yoga centre. After breakfast visit to a village to experience tantric puja. Afternoon free for independent activities. Evening meditation in a yoga centre. O/N-Bhubaneswar.
DAY-8 : BHUBANESWAR-KONARK-PURI
After breakfast proceed to Puri. En route visit to the Dhauli-the Buddhist peace pagoda, pipli appliqué market, Sun temple Konark (UNESCO World heritage site), Evening free for independent activities.
DAY-9 : PURI
After breakfast visit to the temple of universal God Lord Jagannath. Then visit to the cremation ground, Loknath temple. Evening meditation in a yoga centre. O/N-Puri.
DAY-10 : PURI Departure
In time transfer to Airport to connect flight for onwards journey.
